name: flightpath
description: Automate GitHub Copilot with structured prompt workflows

flightpath.promptsDirectory.description: Directory containing prompt files relative to workspace root

flightpath.scriptTimeout.description: Timeout for end condition scripts in milliseconds

flightpath.autoAttachFiles.description: Automatically attach files referenced with #file: syntax
flightpath.autoAttachFiles.markdownDescription: Automatically process `#file:` references in prompts and attach file content as XML. Disable to send prompts as-is without automatic file attachment.

flightpath.chatUseNativeAttachments.description: Use VS Code's native attachment commands in Chat mode
flightpath.chatUseNativeAttachments.markdownDescription: When enabled (default), FlightPath uses VS Code's native `attachFile` and `attachSelection` commands for clean UI in Chat mode. When disabled, uses raw XML attachment (reliable but shows raw text in chat). **Note:** Native attachments have a known VS Code bug with multiple file ranges - disable if you encounter issues. This setting only affects Chat mode; CLI mode always uses XML attachment.

enumDescriptions: Open Copilot Chat in the panel (recommended)
Open Copilot Chat in an editor tab
Open Copilot Chat in a new window
flightpath.chatWindowLocation.description: Choose where to open GitHub Copilot Chat for automation
flightpath.chatWindowLocation.markdownDescription: Choose where to open GitHub Copilot Chat for automation. **Chat Panel** is recommended for most users.

flightpath.showCliOutput.description: Show Copilot CLI output in the Output panel
flightpath.showCliOutput.markdownDescription: Show Copilot CLI output (prompts, responses, statistics) in the **Output** panel for visibility during workflow execution. Disable for background-only execution.

enumDescriptions: Use Copilot CLI (command-line automation - DEFAULT, better reliability & control)
Use Copilot Chat window (legacy UI automation, fallback if CLI unavailable)
flightpath.copilotIntegrationMode.description: Choose how FlightPath interacts with GitHub Copilot
flightpath.copilotIntegrationMode.markdownDescription: Choose how FlightPath interacts with GitHub Copilot. **CLI mode** (default) provides better reliability, deterministic completion, and model selection. Chat mode is available as fallback.

flightpath.copilotCliModel.description: AI model to use with Copilot CLI
flightpath.copilotCliModel.markdownDescription: Select the AI model for Copilot CLI. **Claude Sonnet 4.5** (default) provides the best balance of performance and capability.

flightpath.copilotCliAllowedDirs.description: Additional directories to allow Copilot CLI to access (beyond workspace)
flightpath.copilotCliAllowedDirs.markdownDescription: List of additional directory paths that Copilot CLI can access. Workspace folders are automatically included.

flightpath.copilotCliToolPermissions.description: Tool permission mode for Copilot CLI
flightpath.copilotCliToolPermissions.markdownDescription: Control which tools Copilot CLI can use. **Allow All** (default) grants full access to all tools.

flightpath.defaultMaxRetries.description: Default number of retries when retryPrompt is specified but maxRetries is not
flightpath.defaultMaxRetries.markdownDescription: Default number of retries to use when a `retryPrompt` is specified in an end condition but `maxRetries` is not explicitly set. Use `-1` for unlimited retries, `0` to disable default retries, or `1-100` for a specific limit. **Default: 3**

flightpath.defaultRetryPrompt.default:
**Validation Failed** (Attempt {retryCount}/{maxRetries})

**Expected:** `{expectedValue}`
**Actual:** `{actualValue}`

**Output:**
```
{scriptOutput}
```

Please fix the issues above and try again.
flightpath.defaultRetryPrompt.description: Default retry prompt template when maxRetries is specified but retryPrompt is not
flightpath.defaultRetryPrompt.markdownDescription: Default template for retry prompts when `maxRetries` is specified in an end condition but `retryPrompt` is not. Supports placeholders: `{scriptOutput}`, `{errorOutput}`, `{expectedValue}`, `{actualValue}`, `{retryCount}`, `{maxRetries}`. Leave empty to require explicit retry prompts.

languageModelTools.name: flightpath_response_complete
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this tool when you have finished responding to a FlightPath prompt to signal completion. This allows FlightPath to proceed to the next step in the workflow.
